name: PurePen AI – The 1-Click AI Content Generator for WordPress
author: solverwp

sections.description:
PurePen AI lets you generate publication-ready blog content without leaving the editor. Enter a topic, choose your AI model, and get titles, full post body, and tags in seconds.

Key Features

  • 8 AI Providers — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, Cohere, Groq, DeepSeek, and OpenRouter.
  • Generate Everything — Titles, full HTML content, tags, and meta excerpt in one click.
  • Individual generators — Generate titles, content, or tags separately as needed.
  • Title selector — Pick from 5 AI-generated title options and apply directly to your post.
  • Tag cloud — Select and apply generated tags with one click.
  • Gutenberg and Classic Editor — Full support for both editing experiences.
  • Multiple models per provider — Choose from the latest available models for each provider.
  • Generation history — Optionally log all generations to a searchable history page.
  • Tone and length controls — 8 writing tones and 4 length targets.
  • Multi-language support — Generate content in 18 languages.
  • Provider visibility — Show or hide individual providers in the post editor.
  • Auto-save option — Automatically save generated content to the post draft.

Supported AI Providers

  • Anthropic Claude — Claude Sonnet, Opus, Haiku (console.anthropic.com)
  • OpenAI GPT — GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo (platform.openai.com)
  • Google Gemini — Gemini 1.5 Pro, Flash (aistudio.google.com)
  • Mistral AI — Mistral Large, Medium, Small, Mixtral (console.mistral.ai)
  • Cohere — Command R+, Command R (dashboard.cohere.com)
  • Groq — Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1, Mixtral (console.groq.com)
  • DeepSeek — DeepSeek Chat V3, DeepSeek Reasoner R1 (platform.deepseek.com)
  • OpenRouter — Access many models through a single API key (openrouter.ai)

Privacy Notice

This plugin sends your post topic, title, and content excerpts to external AI provider APIs to generate content. Data is sent directly from your WordPress server to the AI provider you configure. No data is shared with the plugin authors.

Please review the privacy policies of the providers you use:

  • Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/privacy
  • Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mistral https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • Cohere: https://cohere.com/privacy
  • Groq: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the purepen-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to PurePen AI > AI Providers and enter an API key for at least one provider.
  4. Open any post or page to find the PurePen AI panel and start generating content.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. You need an API key from at least one supported AI provider. Most providers offer free tiers or trial credits.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is 100% free and open source (GPL-2.0-or-later). You pay only for API usage to the AI providers you choose.

Which provider should I start with?

We recommend Anthropic Claude Sonnet or OpenAI GPT-4o for the best quality. Groq is the fastest option and offers a generous free tier.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Titles and content are applied directly to the Gutenberg block editor and the Classic Editor.

Where is my API key stored?

API keys are stored in your WordPress database in wp_options. They are never sent to anyone other than the AI provider you configured.

Can I use multiple AI providers?

Yes. Configure API keys for multiple providers and switch between them in the post editor with one click.

Can I disable the plugin without losing data?

Yes. Deactivating the plugin does not delete your settings or history.
